capabilities: Classify a note into a vault folder or a user-defined attribute
Write category and subcategory properties to frontmatter
Move notes to the target folder while links keep working
Bulk-classify unclassified notes in a folder or the whole vault
Undo a run and restore notes and frontmatter
extras: Sending embedded images and classifying image files are marked experimental; images are billed as input tokens and sent twice when an attribute has sub-attributes. The API key is kept in Obsidian's secret storage. README is bilingual (English and Japanese).
problem: Filing notes into folders by hand is slow, and Obsidian has no built-in way to sort notes by what they are about.

relations.evidence: Get an API key at console.typesafe.ai/keys.

summary: Classifies notes with the TypeSafe Jev model and moves them into folders, writing the chosen category and subcategory to frontmatter.
